description: Free wrapper. Runs any catalog tool missing from your tools/list exactly as a direct call: args pass through unchanged and the inner tool's price, payment, read-only profile, result and errors apply verbatim. A missing or unknown name errors pointing to tool_catalog; it cannot call itself. Get names and schemas from tool_catalog first.

args.description: Object matching that tool's inputSchema. Omit if none required.

name.description: Exact tool name from tool_catalog. Not 'use_tool'.

name: use_tool
title: Run any catalog tool
